STASH.title: Stash
STASH.description:
Cards in your [gold]Stash[/gold] stay in your [gold]Stash[/gold] between turns, with your [gold]Stash[/gold] size being equal to your [gold]Storage[/gold].
If a card would be placed in your [gold]Stash[/gold] while it's full, Discard it instead.
STEAL.title: Steal
STEAL.description:
Play the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] if you have [gold]Energy[/gold] equal to or greater than its cost. 
If you don't have enough [gold]Energy[/gold], place it into your [gold]Stash[/gold]. 
Cards played this way don't [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. 
If your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] is empty, you can't [gold]Steal[/gold].
